name: WCORR-WEB-002: Web attack followed by suspicious PHP file creation
description: This rule detects web attack indicators followed by the creation of a PHP file in the WordPress uploads directory.
query:
sequence by agent.id.keyword with maxspan=10m
  [any where rule.id.keyword in
    ("31151", "31103", "31104", "31105")]
  [any where rule.id.keyword == "554"
    and syscheck.event.keyword == "added"
    and syscheck.path.keyword like
      "/var/lib/docker/volumes/web_wp_data/_data/wp-content/uploads/*.php"]
author: Wazuh EQL Correlation
false_positives: PHP creation is joined by endpoint and time, not HTTP client identity; causality is unproven. Legitimate deployments can create PHP files.
setup: Collect web alerts and added-file FIM in the exact WordPress Docker volume path; verify that path locally.
